StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_0: Captain! Shiika! Fei! I've got super~ amazing news! That legendary "Forbidden Zone" has been unsealed!
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_1: "Forbidden Zone"? Sounds so mysterious... Could it be somewhere we've been before?
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_2: That's right! It's F07 [Behaim World]... the part above it!
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_3: To be precise, it's designation F07x - [Behaim World Upper Layer].
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_4: We found it a long time ago, but its danger rating was too high, so it stayed under a mandatory lockdown.
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_5: After repeated assessments, the danger level has dropped steadily to a range where people are allowed to enter.
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_6: So that's it! A sealed world that slept for ages and was once full of danger...
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_7: And now it's woken up, waiting for us to lift its veil! That's so romantic!
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_8: Shiika really focuses on different things than me... But since the danger is lower, it should... probably... be fine?
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_9: The research department is sending people to explore too. We need to redraw the map there while keeping everyone safe.
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_10: An upside-down mirror world, and a freshly unsealed forbidden land... Captain, my adventurous soul is on fire!
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_12: Anyway! It's a lot more stable now, but that place used to be the "Forbidden Zone", so don't let your guard down!
StringDialogText.Dialog200141_Chat_13: Don't worry, Irene, I'll take good care of Shiika and the Captain!
StringDialogText.Dialog200142_Chat_0: We're finally here. Captain, Shiika, stay close to me.
StringDialogText.Dialog200142_Chat_2: Captain~ Fei~ Come look, the upside-down world is so beautiful!
